nodes.description: Public counter incremented for each minted token id in mint and admint.
Public counter of PVP character definitions, incremented in addPVP.
Mapping charId => Pvp struct holding uri, price, units and currentUnits.
Owner address maintained by OwnableUpgradeable, used by onlyOwner checks and withdrawAll.
Pause flag managed by PausableUpgradeable that gates token transfers via _beforeTokenTransfer.
Public initializer that configures ERC721 name/symbol and all inherited upgradeable modules.
Public unrestricted function that sends the whole contract balance to owner() using low-level send.
onlyOwner function creating a new PVP definition, incrementing _charId and writing pvps.
Payable public mint: validates msg.value against pvp.price, increments _tokenId, safe-mints to msg.sender and bumps currentUnits.
Payable onlyOwner mint to an arbitrary recipient, incrementing _tokenId and currentUnits.
onlyOwner function that sets _paused to true.
onlyOwner function that sets _paused to false.
Hook guarded by whenNotPaused that runs before every token transfer, mint and burn.
UUPS upgrade authorization hook restricted with onlyOwner.
Internal burn override delegating to ERC721 and ERC721URIStorage burn logic.
Public view returning the token URI, delegating to super.tokenURI.
Internal pure override returning the fixed Pinata IPFS gateway base URI.
Caller address supplied by the transaction; used as mint recipient and indirectly for sender-based approvals.
Low-level payable(owner()).send(amount) external value transfer performed before any state update, enabling reentrancy.
_safeMint inside mint invokes onERC721Received on the recipient contract, giving external control before currentUnits is incremented.
_safeMint inside admint calls back into the recipient contract, enabling reentrant minting before currentUnits is updated.
pvps[charId].currentUnits++ read-modify-write on state that is performed after the external safe-mint callback.
Token URI string parameter of addPVP stored into the new Pvp struct.
Price parameter of addPVP stored into newPVP.price.
Units parameter of addPVP stored into newPVP.units.
charId parameter of mint used to index the pvps mapping and to update currentUnits.
charId parameter of admint used to index the pvps mapping.
recipient address parameter of admint passed as the safe-mint target.
New implementation address parameter of _authorizeUpgrade used for UUPS upgrades.
tokenId parameter of tokenURI used for the existence check and URI lookup.
tokenId parameter of _burn identifying the token to destroy.
Local variable in withdrawAll holding address(this).balance that is forwarded to owner().
Local Pvp struct built in addPVP from the input parameters before being stored in pvps.
Local copy of the Pvp struct read from pvps[charId] inside mint.
Local copy of the Pvp struct read from pvps[charId] inside admint.

edges.reason: msg.sender is used as the safe-mint recipient inside mint.
charId parameter indexes pvps[charId] inside mint.
Local pvp struct carries pvps[charId] data used for price, units and uri checks in mint.
mint reads and then writes pvps[charId].currentUnits.
mint calls _safeMint which invokes onERC721Received on the recipient before state updates.
mint increments the _tokenId counter.
mint performs pvps[charId].currentUnits++ read-modify-write.
charId parameter indexes pvps[charId] inside admint.
recipient parameter is passed to _safeMint in admint.
Local pvp struct carries pvps[charId] data used for unit checks in admint.
admint calls _safeMint which invokes onERC721Received on the recipient before currentUnits is updated.
admint increments the _tokenId counter.
admint performs pvps[charId].currentUnits++ read-modify-write.
withdrawAll derives the destination from the privileged _owner state variable.
withdrawAll performs an external low-level send of the full balance to owner() with no reentrancy guard.
withdrawAll assigns address(this).balance to local amount.
Local amount is forwarded as the value of the external send call.
_uri parameter flows into the newPVP struct in addPVP.
_price parameter flows into newPVP.price in addPVP.
_units parameter flows into newPVP.units in addPVP.
Local newPVP struct is assembled and stored into pvps[_charId].
addPVP increments the _charId counter before writing the new entry.
addPVP writes the new PVP definition into the pvps mapping.
pause is restricted by onlyOwner which compares against _owner.
pause writes true to the _paused state variable.
unpause is restricted by onlyOwner which compares against _owner.
unpause writes false to the _paused state variable.
_paused is read by the whenNotPaused modifier guarding _beforeTokenTransfer.
newImplementation parameter is consumed by _authorizeUpgrade for UUPS upgrades.
_authorizeUpgrade is restricted by onlyOwner via _owner.
tokenId parameter is used for lookups in tokenURI.
tokenURI calls _baseURI to build the returned URI.
tokenId parameter is passed to the burn logic in _burn.
initialize invokes __Ownable_init which sets the privileged _owner to msg.sender.

normalization_plan.reason: _uri exists only to populate the new PVP entry created by addPVP.
_price exists only to populate the new PVP entry created by addPVP.
_units exists only to populate the new PVP entry created by addPVP.
charId only selects the pvps entry consumed by mint.
charId only selects the pvps entry consumed by admint.
recipient is only forwarded to _safeMint inside admint.
newImplementation is only consumed by the _authorizeUpgrade hook.
tokenId is only used for existence and URI lookups in tokenURI.
tokenId is only used to identify the token destroyed by _burn.
amount is computed solely to be the value of the external send call.
newPVP is a temporary struct that is immediately stored by addPVP.
Local pvp is the memory copy of pvps[charId] read entirely inside mint.
Local pvp is the memory copy of pvps[charId] read entirely inside admint.
